Job title: Growth Product Manager
Northwind Parcel (fictional company, synthetic test fixture)

## About us
Northwind Parcel runs Agile teams. Agile is how we work, and Agile shapes our culture.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Own the product roadmap for checkout.
- Partner with stakeholders across finance. Experience with OKRs is a plus.

Minimum qualifications
- Strong SQL skills.
- Track KPIs every week.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Exposure to Golang.
- A/B testing experience is required.

Benefits & perks
- Learning budget. Data science lunch talks are a plus.
